about.title: About bdoor
about.description: Why we built a Bangladesh-focused company operating system, and how we work.
about.mission1: Starting a business in Bangladesh is not hard because the rules are secret. It is hard because they are scattered: different authorities, different offices, different forms, and no single place that tells you what actually applies to you and in what order.
about.mission2: bdoor exists to be that place. One workspace where you explain what you want to build, get a clear list of what it needs, upload your documents once, see a quote that separates our fee from everyone else’s, and watch each step move.
about.how1: We start by asking. The guided questionnaire branches on your answers, so a local founder with one shop is not asked about capital remittance, and a foreign investor is not left to guess about sector eligibility. From those answers we produce a preliminary recommendation using rules our operations team can inspect and change — not a black box.
about.how2: Then a person takes over. A case manager scopes the work, requests exactly the documents that are needed, and where the matter requires legal or specialist authority, engages a verified partner advocate under a separate agreement with you. Every status change, document view and fee is recorded.
about.limits1: We are not a government authority and we have no influence over any decision an authority makes. We do not present ourselves as a law firm, and we do not give legal advice. Where legal work is required it is done by independent advocates or partner firms under their own engagement with you, and we tell you who they are before anything is shared.
about.limits2: We do not guarantee approval, a visa, a bank account, or a completion date. We give you an estimate, we tell you what it assumes, and we tell you when it changes. Investment and share capital never passes through bdoor.

help_scope.label: Where do you want help?
help_scope.why: This routes you to the right package, questions and review path — Bangladesh setup, ongoing compliance or international formation.

founder_location.label: Where are you based right now?
founder_location.help: This changes which documents you need and whether foreign-investment rules apply.
founder_location.why: Founder location determines whether the incorporation is treated as local or foreign-invested, which changes the documents, the bank process and the approvals involved.

nationality.label: What is your nationality?
nationality.why: Nationality affects sector eligibility, ownership limits and the identity documents we must collect under AML rules.

residence.label: Which country do you currently live in?
residence.why: Residence affects tax registration, address evidence and how your identity documents are verified.

activity.label: What will the business actually do?
activity.help: One or two sentences is enough. For example: “Import cotton fabric and sell to local garment factories.”
activity.why: The activity decides which licences apply and whether the sector is regulated or restricted.

location.label: Where in Bangladesh will the business operate?
location.help: Choose the city or district of your main place of business.
location.why: Trade licences are issued by the local city corporation or municipality, so the fee and process depend on location.

structure.label: Which structure do you have in mind?
structure.why: We use this as a starting point only. If it does not fit your ownership or activity, we will tell you.

options.branch_office: Branch office of a foreign company

owner_count.label: How many owners will there be, including you?
owner_count.why: Some structures have minimum and maximum owner counts, and the count changes the documents we collect.

director_count.label: How many directors will there be?
director_count.why: Company law sets minimum director numbers, and each director needs identity records.

foreign_owners.label: Will any owner be a foreign national or a foreign company?
foreign_owners.why: Foreign ownership triggers investment registration, remittance documentation and additional verification.

entity_owner.label: Will any owner be a company, trust or fund rather than a person?
entity_owner.why: We must identify the natural people who ultimately own or control a corporate shareholder. This is a legal requirement, not a formality.

foreign_ownership_percent.label: Roughly what percentage will be foreign-owned?
foreign_ownership_percent.why: Some sectors cap foreign ownership. The percentage also affects investment-registration steps.

remit_capital.label: Will investment capital be sent into Bangladesh from abroad?
remit_capital.why: Inward remittance needs a specific bank process and an encashment certificate. Getting the order wrong causes real delays.
remit_capital.note: Investment or share capital is never paid to bdoor. It goes to a bank account in the company's name through the proper channel.

founder_will_work.label: Will you live or work in Bangladesh yourself?
founder_will_work.why: Working or residing in Bangladesh needs a visa and, usually, a work permit. Owning a company does not give you either.

import_export.label: Will the business import or export goods?
import_export.why: Importing needs an IRC and exporting needs an ERC. Both depend on having a bank account and a trade licence first.

hire_employees.label: Will you hire employees in Bangladesh?
hire_employees.why: Employment brings payroll, tax deduction and, above certain sizes, labour registrations.

regulated_activity.label: Is your activity in a regulated sector?
regulated_activity.help: For example travel, recruitment, food, pharmaceuticals, telecom, finance, education or construction.
regulated_activity.why: Regulated sectors need approval from a specific authority before or after incorporation, and eligibility must be checked first.

need_address.label: Do you need help with a registered business address?
need_address.why: A registrable address is required. If you do not have one yet, we need to plan for it before the trade licence stage.

start_window.label: When would you like to start?
start_window.why: Timing changes what we prioritise and whether documents can be prepared in parallel.

existing_business.label: Does this business already exist?
existing_business.why: Existing companies need different documents — we work from your current registrations rather than starting fresh.

existing_registrations.label: Which registrations do you already have?
existing_registrations.why: Knowing what exists avoids duplicate applications and tells us what needs renewal.
